relations.subject: Ajahn Sumedho
relations.evidence: During Ajahn Chah’s visit to Europe in 1978 he asked his senior Western disciple, Ajahn Sumedho, to accept an invitation to establish a Theravada Buddhist monastery in Britain.

relations.subject: Munindo Bhikkhu
relations.evidence: Our teacher, the Venerable Ajahn Chah, had been seriously ill for a number of years.

relations.subject: Ajahn Sumedho
relations.evidence: Not only was a Theravada training monastery well established in the UK – Cittaviveka in West Sussex – but Ajahn Sumedho further initiated and supported the building of seven other monasteries

meta.title: Seeing the Way: Discerning Timeless Truth in Traditional Buddhist Teachings
